subcategory_text: Risk responses are identified, prioritized, and implemented.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: RA-5 (Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning), RA-3(1) (System-Facing Risk Assessment)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.8 (Management of technical vulnerabilities)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.RA-06 (risk responses identified)
implementation_examples: For each prioritised privacy risk, identify the set of candidate risk responses (mitigate, accept, transfer, avoid) and the specific measures to be applied
Document the rationale for the chosen response and the residual risk after treatment
Track responses to completion and review residual risk on a defined cadence
assessment_objectives: Determine whether candidate risk responses are identified for each prioritised risk
Determine whether the chosen response and its rationale are documented
Determine whether residual risk is estimated and tracked
Determine whether risk-response status is reviewed on a defined cadence
